context: Two teens swap relationship jokes on the way home
purpose: Teach: 曇り/飼い主/異性/ダンナ/さらさ/だからといって/親指/ユーモア

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ聞いてよ、ウチのダンナがさ〜って母さんが愚痴ってて、もう曇り空みたいな顔してた。
lines.en: Hey listen, my mom was complaining 'my hubby this, my hubby that,' her face was like a cloudy sky.
lines.style: Casual teen girl, gossipy and animated tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる〜。でもさ、結婚って異性の友人が一人増えるだけって誰か言ってたよ。
lines.en: Totally get it. But you know, someone said marriage is just gaining one more friend of the opposite sex.
lines.style: Laid-back teen boy, joking and dry delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それ深いね。でも父さんなんてさらさら反省する気ないっぽいし。
lines.en: That's deep. But my dad doesn't seem to have any intention of reflecting at all.
lines.style: Teen girl, eye-rolling sarcastic energy here.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ウチも似たようなもん。母さんが文句言うと、父さんは黙って親指を立てるだけ。
lines.en: Mine's similar. When mom complains, dad just silently gives a thumbs up.
lines.style: Boy delivers deadpan joke with mock seriousness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ちょっと、それユーモアのセンスありすぎでしょ！犬の飼い主みたいに扱われてんじゃん。
lines.en: Hey, that's way too much comedic sense! He's being treated like a dog by its owner.
lines.style: Teen girl bursts out laughing, playful exclamation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: まあ平和だからいいんだよ。だからといってマネしたくはないけどね。
lines.en: Well, it's peaceful, so it's fine. That said, I don't really want to copy it though.
lines.style: Boy shrugs verbally, light philosophical tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: だよね。私もそんな結婚は絶対イヤ。曇りなき青空みたいな恋がしたい！
lines.en: Right? I absolutely refuse that kind of marriage. I want love like a cloudless blue sky!
lines.style: Teen girl declares dramatically with sparkly enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 出たよ理想論。じゃあな、また明日！
lines.en: There it is, the idealism. See you, later tomorrow!
lines.style: Boy waves off, casual parting tease tone.
